items.name: Thick Engraveable Wood Hanger
items.reference: Your Badrutt's Palace reference: warm wood, brass hook, an understated engraved crest on the flat shoulder. These chase that heft + engraveable face in Hill-Country tones.
items.note: Engraving tip: natural/light wood gives the crispest logo contrast; warm walnut gives the subtle, elegant burn of the Badrutt's crest. Engrave the flat shoulder face.

options.name: Contoured Deluxe Suit Hanger — Walnut
options.specs: Beech, walnut finish · thick 18″ contour · chrome hook · non-slip bar
options.why: Genuinely thick & heavy, warm walnut suits the ranch, and a 3-pack lets you test your laser before scaling.

options.name: Tailor Made® Coat Hanger — Butterscotch + Brass
options.specs: Grade-A German beech · 2⅝″ sculpted shoulder · solid brass hook
options.why: Closest to Badrutt's — heirloom weight, brass hook, warm wood. Buy one to prototype.

options.name: Contoured Suit Hanger w/ Locking Bar — Natural
options.specs: Natural hardwood, clear lacquer · 17″ · wooden locking bar
options.why: Lowest cost per unit and the crispest engraving contrast; trade-off is a slimmer profile.

options.name: Hanger Project Walnut Long-Handle Shoe Horn
options.specs: Solid walnut, ~24″+, deerskin strap · handcrafted in Dallas, TX
options.why: Heirloom US-made walnut from the same house as the hanger pick — premium and on-brand.

options.name: Personalized Engraved 7″ Natural Wood Shoe Horn
options.specs: Natural wood 7″ · handheld · smooth engraving face
options.why: The only turnkey option where the supplier laser-engraves your seal for you — no equipment needed.

options.name: Long Wooden Shoehorn
options.specs: Birch, 22″ · hangs by cord loop
options.why: Rock-bottom price for a real long wood shoehorn; brand the handle in-house. The everyday workhorse.

items.name: Standing Shoehorn / Valet Block
items.note: Honest note: a long shoehorn seated in its own wooden base block is a genuinely scarce category — only two US-buyable pieces verified. The third is the closest verified low-cost engravable wood shoehorn (handheld). Or pair a Shoehorn pick above with an in-house-engraved walnut block.

options.name: Standing Shoehorn (Kime, by Mikiya Kobayashi)
options.specs: Walnut horn 28″ + walnut base block 4.7″ · leather loop · Asahikawa craft
options.why: Best-in-class: a true standing shoehorn in a substantial walnut block — a flat face made for your seal.

options.name: Kime Shoehorn with Wooden Stand
options.specs: Solid walnut 27.5″ + matching wooden stand · made in Japan
options.why: Nearly the same concept at ~half the price, with frictionless Amazon stock and US shipping.

options.name: Personalized Engraved Wood Shoe Horn (closest verified)
options.specs: Natural wood 7″ · handheld (does not stand) · supplier-engraved
options.why: Flagged honestly: handheld, not standing — the closest verified low-cost engravable wood piece if the standing form isn't essential.

options.name: Triple Wall Mount + Signature Amber Glass Dispensers
options.specs: Matte-black or brass triple bracket + 16oz amber glass pumps
options.brand: In-house laser/UVDTF on glass, or supplier-engraved
options.why: Amber glass + matte-black/brass reads premium-rustic, and the smooth glass is the only option you can truly brand in-house.

options.name: Hotel-at-Home Triple Wall-Mounted Set — Amber
options.specs: Shatter-safe amber PET ×3 · no-drill adhesive mounts · funnel
options.why: Cheapest turnkey amber system, shatter-safe for a rental shower — buy one, UVDTF a label, done.

options.name: Wall Mount Pump — Triple (or Single $50)
options.specs: Brushed stainless, rust-proof, 15oz/chamber · 5-yr warranty
options.why: The genuine hotel-grade fixture — bulletproof sealed metal, no glass to break. Modern-luxe lean.

options.name: Wooden Bottle Opener — Walnut/Cherry + Stainless
options.specs: Stainless speed-opener faced with real hardwood · made in USA
options.brand: Supplier engraves free — or in-house on the wood face
options.why: Real walnut + solid stainless reads exactly 'Hill Country bar,' buyable as one, and the only pick that supports both supplier and in-house branding.

options.name: Stainless + Leather Bottle Opener (8-pack blanks)
options.specs: Stainless + genuine leather face · brown tones
options.why: Crushes the price target, leather-on-steel matches the palette, and it's purpose-built as a laser blank.

options.name: Rustic Cast Iron Wall-Mounted Opener
options.specs: Solid cast iron, antique-brown, wall-mount fixture
options.brand: Mount on an in-house engraved wood backer
options.why: The most 'ranch fixture' look at under $10; brand it via a laser-engraved wood backer board.

items.name: Linen-Feel Cocktail Napkins
items.note: Like the Badrutt's napkin: a disposable linen-feel (airlaid) napkin with a printed logo. Limelight prints your seal at the lowest minimum (25); Caspari and Hoffmaster are premium natural blanks you can stamp in-house. Runner-ups: For Your Party (foil) and Champagne & Ink (100 min, ~$1.18 printed).

options.name: "Linun" Personalized Linen-Feel Cocktail Napkins
options.specs: Airlaid linen-feel · 5×5″ · one-time use · cream/natural
options.why: Lowest MOQ (25) and a $10 flat setup — the closest match to the Badrutt's printed linen-feel napkin at boutique quantity.

options.name: Linen Border Cocktail Napkins — Natural
options.specs: Triple-ply paper-linen · natural linen border · 5×5″
options.brand: Blank: stamp seal in-house or use as-is
options.why: The most premium-feeling blank in a true cream/natural tone at the lowest commitment — Caspari is the luxury name in paper-linen.

options.name: Linen-Like Natural Kraft Beverage Napkin
options.specs: Natural kraft linen-feel airlaid · rustic tone
options.why: Ultra-low cost and the most rustic natural tone; a case of 1,000 for a property that stamps in-house.

items.name: Plain Low-Cost Blankets
items.note: Why woven, not fleece: flat-woven cotton (waffle / basketweave) has no raised nap or static, so it sheds pet hair and lint instead of grabbing it like polar fleece. All plain and embroiderable. More options: DII Herringbone (~$20, Amazon) and the Superior Diamond-weave throw.

options.name: Waffle Weave Cotton Throw, 50×60
options.specs: 100% pre-washed cotton waffle weave · Natural/Olive/Grey/White · 50×60
options.why: Flat woven cotton — sheds lint instead of grabbing it. Exact 50×60, true neutrals, under ~$25, single-unit.

options.name: Mikala 100% Cotton Waffle Throw, 50×60
options.specs: 100% combed cotton waffle · Oatmeal/Taupe/Grey · 50×60
options.why: Another woven-cotton waffle in true oatmeal/taupe, single-unit at Target — same anti-lint behavior.

options.name: Basketweave Thermal Cotton Throw, 50×60
options.specs: 100% cotton flat basketweave thermal · Charcoal/Taupe/Khaki/Ivory · 50×60
options.why: The tightest, flattest weave here = the best lint-shedder of all; just over $25 with confirmed neutral colors.

items.name: Disposable Sewing Kit
items.note: A genuine disposable matchbook/folder kit that ALSO prints your logo on the website is rare. ProImprint (flat case) has the lowest cost + setup; ImprintItems prints a true paper matchbook cover (quote-only, ~$500 min). All print the seal for you — no in-house work needed.

options.name: Logo Sewing Kit — flat snap case
options.specs: Thin flat case · threads, needles, pins, buttons · logo on front
options.why: Lowest per-unit ($0.83) and setup ($34.99) of the disposable-style kits, website-branded, clean amenity look.

options.name: Matchbook Folder Sewing Kit
options.specs: True paper matchbook folder — the authentic hotel format · cover printed
options.why: The truest disposable hotel matchbook, with your logo offset-printed across the cover. Pricing is quote-only.

options.name: Sewing Kit #962
options.specs: Compact case · multi-thread, needles, pins, buttons
options.why: A turnkey website-branded kit from a trusted US promo house — clean and cheap at 250.

items.name: Pens with Heft & Character
items.reference: Your exemplar: a substantial cream-lacquer barrel with gold trim, twist-action — a real hotel pen, not promo SWAG.
items.note: Honest tradeoff: under $5 you can get heavy brass (the Executive — but black/gold, not cream) OR the cream/gold look (slim, lighter). A cream-lacquer + gold + HEAVY pen isn't stocked at this price — sample the brass Executive and the white/gold Slim before a 100-unit buy, or go ~$16 (Garland Hamilton) for an exact heavy cream/gold match.

options.name: Executive Metal Pen — solid brass barrel
options.specs: Solid BRASS barrel, lacquer finish, twist · gold-toned engraving
options.why: The only verified genuinely HEAVY pen in budget — real brass, classic executive feel, gold imprint. Black lacquer + gold seal is the most upscale combo (no cream offered).

options.name: Slim Metal Pen with Gold Accents — White
options.specs: White metal barrel + gold trim, twist · the cream/gold look
options.why: Closest to your exemplar's cream-and-gold palette and cheapest — but slim, so sample it to confirm the weight clears the 'not throwaway' bar.

options.name: Metal Twist Pen — Champagne/Gold
options.specs: Champagne/white + gold trim metal barrel, twist · laser-engravable
options.why: Cream/champagne + gold with cleaner laser engraving and some metal weight; the pearl cap is a glam accent — order Champagne for the closest match.

items.name: Waxed Canvas Tote Bags
items.note: The genuine waxed-canvas + full-grain leather + brass combo from US makers mostly lands $130+ (which is why ARTIFACT is $140). Rogue ($65, in stock) is the best 'same look for less.' Still want a plain cheap canvas tote to brand a stack? The BagzDepot 12oz USA natural (~$19) is the bulk play.

options.name: Waxed Canvas Tote — leather + antique brass
options.specs: Waxed canvas · full-grain leather strap · antique brass rivets · Brown/Green
options.why: The ARTIFACT look at ~half price and buyable today — real leather + antique brass + waxed canvas in earthy brown/green.

options.name: Market Tote in Waxed Canvas
options.specs: 14.7oz waxed canvas · full-grain veg-tan leather · SOLID brass · Tan/Olive/Charcoal
options.why: Spec-for-spec the closest ARTIFACT clone and cheapest — solid brass, US-made, perfect palette. Caveat: colors were sold out (set a restock alert).

options.name: Utility Tote — 18oz Waxed (Made in USA)
options.specs: 18oz waxed duck canvas · full-grain leather grips · Brown/Briquette
options.why: The in-stock American-made step-up — heavyweight 18oz waxed canvas and full-grain leather; under the $140 ARTIFACT (no brass).

items.name: Custom Paisley Bandana
items.note: Two routes: (B) a traditional paisley with a blank CENTER MEDALLION your seal prints into — OutfitYourLogo, ~$555 for 100 incl. setup; or (A) FULL CUSTOM, your seal baked into the paisley — The Bandanna Company (Hav-A-Hank), screen min 50, quote pricing. Local option: Bandana Supply (Sugar Land, TX). Note: bandana.com / nationalbandana are defunct.

options.name: Open-Center Paisley Bandana, USA Made
options.specs: 22×22″ 100% cotton · classic paisley + 10×10 blank center · khaki/olive/navy/rust/red/black
options.why: Exactly your 'paisley with a blank spot for the logo' idea — traditional paisley, USA-made cotton, every earthy color, with clean 100-unit pricing.

options.name: Custom Paisley — logo baked into the design
options.specs: 100% cotton · your seal printed INTO a full custom paisley · US heritage maker
options.why: The true full-design route — they bake your seal into the paisley itself. Achievable at ~100 via their 50-pc screen minimum; call for the 100-unit total.

options.name: USA-Made Paisley Bandana, 22″
options.specs: 22×22″ 100% cotton · stock paisley, logo in a corner/side strip
options.why: Fully-verified turnkey 100-unit pricing and free shipping; the seal prints in a corner strip rather than centered.

options.name: SuperScrape Impressions Custom Logo Mat
options.specs: 100% nitrile rubber, 3/16″ thick · up to 6×8′ · logo molded in
options.why: A genuinely thick, heavy all-rubber scraper with the seal permanently molded in — survives Hill-Country sun, rain and boots.

options.name: Rubber Logo Scraper Mat (Custom)
options.specs: All-rubber scraper cleats · HD 4-color print + PMS match
options.why: Same all-rubber outdoor concept ~$50 cheaper at the small size, still qty 1.

options.name: Completely Custom Coir Doormat
options.specs: Natural coir on thick vinyl base · UV-printed · made in USA
options.why: Warmest 'ranch-porch' look — natural coir, US small-shop made, the cheapest of the three. Confirm made-to-order stock.

items.name: Brass Umbrella Stand
items.note: Material reality: new clean-cylinder 'brass' stands (Glaro and its commercial twins) are satin-brass FINISH on rust-proof aluminum, not solid brass — a genuine solid-brass smooth tube only exists vintage or custom-fabricated. For true solid brass, the vintage Chairish piece is the real thing (an open serpent-ring form, not a smooth tube).

options.name: Glaro 921 Satin Brass Cylinder Stand
options.specs: Clean 23″H × 9″ cylinder · satin brass on spun aluminum · water tray
options.why: The cleanest 'brass tube' silhouette available new — a plain polished cylinder, tarnish-proof so an engraved seal stays sharp, commercial-grade, under $200.

options.name: Glaro 259 Combination Cylinder — Satin Brass
options.specs: Larger 23″H × 15″ tube · ~20 lb · bigger branding face
options.why: Same brand and clean-tube look but heavier (20 lb, won't tip) with a bigger face for the seal — for a high-traffic entry.

options.name: Early-20thC French SOLID Brass Holder (vintage)
options.specs: Genuine SOLID brass with natural patina · 24″H · Art Nouveau serpent rings
options.why: If you want truly solid brass, this is it — a real vintage piece. Trade-off: an open ring form (not a smooth tube), so engraving isn't practical.

options.name: The Selva Auto-Open Bamboo Stick Umbrella (48″)
options.specs: Bamboo shaft + handle · vented RPET canopy · auto-open
options.why: Natural bamboo = the warm wood/canvas look, vented = windproof, and a full multi-color logo print is included with zero setup fee.

options.name: Aluminum Stick Umbrella with Wood Handle (48″)
options.specs: Aluminum shaft · wood grip · nylon canopy · khaki · auto-open
options.why: The qty-1, lowest-cost, brand-it-yourself play — khaki + wood handle nails the neutral palette.

options.name: Classic Curved-Handle Umbrella (54″)
options.specs: 54″ arc · dark wood crook handle with brass accents · auto-open
options.why: The dressiest silhouette — full walking-stick with real wood crook + brass. Wood + brass = the Poco Loco material story.

items.name: Cornhole Boards (blank for DTF)
items.note: You'll DTF the seal yourself, so these ship blank. Raw 3/4″ Baltic birch (CornholeAce) is the flattest, most premium transfer base — a light clear seal first improves UVDTF grip and weatherproofs it. Runner-up: Slick Woody's vinyl-coated white top is transfer-ready with no prep (confirm stock).

options.name: Plain Unfinished Set — 3/4″ Baltic Birch (No Poly)
options.specs: 2 boards · 3/4″ Baltic birch top + frame · folding legs · raw, no graphics
options.why: The only verified in-stock true 3/4″ Baltic birch blank with no poly and no graphics — the smoothest, most premium DTF base, tournament-grade.

options.name: 4×2 Natural Wood Set + Case
options.specs: 2 boards · 1/2″ varnished cabinet-grade ply · carry case (bags separate)
options.why: Lowest-price in-stock set from a reputable brand; the light varnished top takes a DTF transfer well after a quick scuff-sand.

options.name: Quick-Ship Blank Top — 3/4″ Baltic Birch (No Clear Coat)
options.specs: 2 boards · 3/4″ Baltic birch · blank top, no clear coat — built for custom art
options.why: Purpose-built blank top for custom artwork (no clear coat to fight) — ideal for DTF. Was sold out at research; confirm restock.
